notes: Machine-readable NASA test-target map. ra_text/dec_text are exactly the strings a judge can paste into the app. All coordinates are ICRS J2000.

targets.name: Barnard's Star
targets.note: High proper motion — 10.3 arcsec/yr, the fastest star relative to the Sun
targets.why_it_matters: Moves ~2.5 SPHEREx pixels per year, so a multi-epoch blink shows real motion against fixed background stars.
targets.expected_behavior: Multiple epochs returned; blink shows the star drifting relative to the stellar background; mover finder ranks it near the top.
targets.fallback: If no epoch covers the position, a coverage-pending card with an IRSA deep link is shown.

targets.name: Epsilon Indi B
targets.note: Brown dwarf pair (Ba/Bb) 3.6 pc away, wide orbit around Epsilon Indi A
targets.why_it_matters: Bright in the near-infrared but faint in visible light — a good test of SPHEREx sensitivity at southern declinations.
targets.expected_behavior: Southern target served by QR2/QR3; spectrum peaks in H/K band; blink shows a faint point source.
targets.fallback: Southern coverage is sparser; coverage-pending card is acceptable and is documented in VALIDATION.md.

targets.name: WISE 0855
targets.note: WISE 0855-0714 — coldest known brown dwarf, ~7.5 pc, very high proper motion
targets.why_it_matters: Extreme red colours and rapid motion make it an ideal difference-imaging target.
targets.expected_behavior: Exact sexagesimal coordinates parse and render; source appears only at longer wavelengths.
targets.fallback: If the source is below the detection limit in a band, the image still renders with catalogue overlay showing the expected position.

targets.name: RW Aurigae
targets.note: Young stellar object with deep, unpredictable optical fading events
targets.why_it_matters: A variability test: the difference image should light up at the star position even when nothing moves.
targets.expected_behavior: Bright source; difference mode shows a strong point-source residual; mover finder must NOT rank it high (it does not move).
targets.fallback: Saturated pixels are flagged OVERFLOW and masked; the metadata panel reports the masked fraction.

targets.name: R Draconis
targets.note: Mira-type long-period variable, high northern declination
targets.why_it_matters: Tests high-declination coverage where SPHEREx scanning is densest, and large-amplitude variability in the difference image.
targets.expected_behavior: Bright, strongly variable source; large difference-image residuals between epochs separated by months.
targets.fallback: Very bright star may saturate many pixels; the app masks OVERFLOW/BLOOM and reports them.
